Players Committee card image of [[Jedi Levitation (V)]] (original printing), game text: “USED: If you just drew a character for destiny, take that card into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. LOST: Use 3 Force to retrieve a non-[Maintenance] character into hand.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/jedilevitation.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
